profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at WPP Media, Data & Technology Solutions
profile.summary:
• Data Warehouse design, modeling, development and implementation of the ETL process, OLAP cubes, and reporting. Use of SSAS, SSIS, and Essbase 6.5 and 11.1

• SQL Server database administration of tables, views, indexes, stored procedures, SQL jobs, linked servers, security, and backups. Query and index optimization.

• Website design, programming and standards development using ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, Visual Basic 6.0, and HTML and Visual SourceSafe. 

I'm currently studying to gain my MCTS: Microsoft SQL Server 2008, Implementation and Maintenance certification.

Specialties: SQL Server 2008 R2. Business Intelligence/Data warehouse design and development, and database administration.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Systems Analyst (contract)
positions.description:
Supporting North American SQL Server 2008 R2/Essbase financial reporting systems.
•	Developed a system for creating historical snapshots of financial databases using MS SQL Server 2008R2 backend and Essbase Cubes for reporting. Optimized SQL code and indexing by analyzing execution plans and by using DMVs.
•	Developed a Power Tool market share analysis database for Bosch, Skil, Rotozip and Dremel product lines utilizing Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2, Microsoft SQL Server 2008 Analysis Services and an Excel with VBA UI.
•	Worked on a CIP (continuous improvement process) project gaining international attention by optimizing ETL processing time from a 4 hour duration to 50 minutes.
•	Maintenance of Balance sheet and P&L store procedures and jobs.

positions.title: Sr Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Lead developer of the corporate data warehouse using SQL 2000, SQL 2005 and SQL 2008.
• Strong knowledge in ETL processing, OLTP/OLAP systems, normalized and denormalized (DW and     ODS) models, dimensional strategies, surrogate key and star schema use.
• Store procedures, cursors, views and jobs scheduling. Conversion of DTS packages to SSIS.
• Analysis, design and development of reports for corporate directors using T-SQL, ProClarity, and Excel with VBA.
• Special projects for the actuarial department and upper management using agile programming methodology.
• ETL process development from multiple sources: SQL, DB2, ADABAS, VSAM, and flat files.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst then Database Administrator
positions.description:
• Table design, indexing, and optimization.
• Backups and maintenance plans. 
• Capacity and growth planning.
• Set up and monitoring of snap-shot and merge replication.
• Cube and dimension design/creation and security using MS Analysis Services. ETL process using DTS packages.
• ProClarity administrator and trainer.
• Project planning using MS Project.

positions.title: Financial Analyst, Programmer then Sr Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Performed a wide range of programming and system analysis functions including: major system conversions, program development and modification, testing, system implementations, user training, documentation writing, and PC application support.

• Conversion of Natural 2 and RPG II accounting applications on IBM 4381 to JDEdwards     accounting package on an IBM AS400.  CL programming.
• System conversions from batch RPG II processing and PC based systems to on-line Natural/ADABAS.
• Responsible for system analysis, database design and setup within Predict data dictionary, program development, testing, data conversion, and user training.   
• Converted general ledger, inventory, and corporate personnel systems to Natural from   RPG II and dBase.  JCL programming as needed.
• DBaseII and MS Access support for marketing services department.

positions.title: Staff Accountant
positions.description:
Sales, payroll, and inventory analysis for 39 retail outlets.  Designed and implemented sales reporting system for retail outlets.  
• Established procedures and programmed point-of-sale terminals for sales entry.  
• Financial analysis using Lotus123.  
• Involved in chapter 11 ballot process.  
• Special projects reporting directly to the president and treasurer.
